title: Report: GTA VI Includes Hidden Memorial for Developers' Late Family Members
description: RockstarINTEL reports that Grand Theft Auto VI features a hidden memorial in Leonida honoring deceased relatives of Rockstar developers. The tribute includes names such as Bev Green, mother of QA developer Matt Green, and Elhuntry and Jade Radcliff, father and daughter of production designer Terranc
youtubeTitle: GTA VI Secret Memorial Honors Devs' Late Family Members
socialHook: GTA VI hides a touching memorial for Rockstar developers' late family members in Leonida.

sections.heading: Memorial Discovered in Leonida
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL reports that Grand Theft Auto VI contains a hidden memorial located just north of Hamlet in the state of Leonida. According to a GAMER2GO report cited by RockstarINTEL, the wall features several names of people who passed away during the game's development. The memorial is not a typical Easter egg but a personal tribute from the development team.

sections.heading: Developers Share Personal Stories
paragraphs: QA developer Matt Green posted on Instagram that his mother, Bev Green, who died in March 2026, is among the names. Green said she was excited to see the game he worked on but never saw the finished project. Production designer Terrance Radcliff shared on X that his late father Elhuntry Radcliff and daughter Jade Radcliff appear side by side on the memorial, calling it an honor to have them remembered in GTA VI.

sections.heading: Full List of Names Not Yet Confirmed
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL notes that the complete list of names on the memorial has not been explained, so other developers may have honored loved ones there. The discovery adds a layer of real-world emotion to the game's hidden details, distinct from usual in-game references. Rockstar Games has not officially commented on the memorial.
